ambiguities.text: The specification doesn't define validation mechanisms for verifying peer-claimed block ranges.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes must verify claims through actual block requests and track peer reliability over time.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'lacks connections to peers with the necessary block range' for disconnection doesn't specify how necessity is determined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume necessity is determined by current sync requirements or pending block requests.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between multiple [startBlock, endBlock] tuples in SendBlockRange is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume multiple tuples represent non-contiguous available ranges, and nodes should union them for total availability.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes assume peer-advertised block ranges are honest until proven otherwise.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious peers could waste bandwidth and time by claiming ranges they don't have.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot coordinate enough Sybil nodes to completely prevent honest block range discovery.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Network could be partitioned or sync could be indefinitely delayed through false range advertisements.

implicit_assumptions.description: Historical block storage solutions (per EIP-4444) will be available before wide-scale block range pruning.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Historical blocks may become unavailable if pruning outpaces alternative storage deployment.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes maintain accurate knowledge of their own block availability.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Honest nodes could inadvertently advertise incorrect ranges, appearing as malicious peers.
